name: smwgraphics-castlevania-dracula-x-stage
title: Castlevania: Dracula X - Stage 7 (Vertical Section)
description:
The tower-like tileset seen in the final level of Castlevania: Dracula X, where Richter has to dodge medusa heads and spear knights, while riding flying platforms. It uses the last colors of palette 4, while keeping the graphics from cement and note blocks intact.

A good fit for tower (vertical) levels.
